originalSource:
rem Investigating the primality of
rem numbers of the form 2n^2 - 1
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=216
rem Count the n from 2 to Limit for
rem which 2 n^2 - 1 is prime

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

option Limit integer = 50000000

rem Test each number for primality.
Count = 0
for N in 2 to Limit
  if 2 * N * N - 1 in primes
    Count += 1
  end
end
Answer = Count
Answer print
